quotas.shortfall_rule: CANNOT_CHECK_STRATUM_SHORTFALL; never replace a short stratum after outcome access

custody_contract.gold_owner: independent curator/adjudicator, not ORION candidate code or authors' rules
custody_contract.gold_reveal_rule: all candidate and baseline predictions plus visible-packet hashes must be sealed before gold is revealed
custody_contract.disagreement_rule: retain raw adjudicator labels and disagreement; unresolved disagreement is CANNOT_CHECK, not majority-forced binary gold

source_disjointness.duplicate_cluster_rule: exact source/version pair and materially equivalent change event count once

baseline_identities.ALWAYS_REUSE: emit REUSE for every adjudicable cluster
baseline_identities.ALWAYS_REOPEN: emit REOPEN for every adjudicable cluster; safety ceiling
baseline_identities.VERSION_PROVENANCE_ONLY: REOPEN iff the frozen source/version/provenance receipt records a material version/provenance change; missing receipt => CANNOT_CHECK
baseline_identities.SEMANTIC_DIFF_ONLY: REOPEN iff the separately frozen outcome-blind semantic-diff preprocessor marks a material semantic change; missing/failed parse => CANNOT_CHECK
baseline_identities.CONFIDENCE_ONLY: admissible only for a source with a native pre-outcome confidence signal and a threshold frozen on development data; otherwise this arm is CANNOT_CHECK_NOT_MEANINGFUL
baseline_identities.CANDIDATE: current responsibility/closure-aware policy, exact executable identity to be frozen before protected predictions

strongest_noncandidate_selection: select exactly one non-candidate arm on the development split before primary/replication gold; the selected baseline id is immutable in the protected result packet

primary_analysis.paired_unsound_reuse_improvement: I(strongest baseline unsound reuse) - I(candidate unsound reuse)
primary_analysis.uncertainty: deterministic 10000-resample cluster bootstrap, SHA-256 counter stream, equal-tail 95% interval
primary_analysis.downstream_noninferiority: mean candidate downstream validity - mean ALWAYS_REOPEN downstream validity >= -0.01
primary_analysis.heterogeneity_gate: positive direction in >=3/4 strata and every leave-one-stratum-out primary analysis
primary_analysis.replication_gate: source-disjoint replication mean paired unsound-reuse improvement > 0

leakage_guards: gold label absent from every candidate-visible feature manifest
gold reveal occurs after prediction seal
same visible packet hash supplied to all compared policies
no threshold or baseline reselection after protected gold
negative_result_policy: Every adverse terminal is retained as the scientific result. No stratum replacement, relabeling, denominator change or baseline reselection is permitted after protected outcomes.
